subject: Follow-up: Redwood demo — economic buyer & next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Turner <aisha.turner@skyline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -0000
Subject: Follow-up: Redwood demo — economic buyer & next steps

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for taking the demo with Marissa this morning — appreciate you walking us through Skyline's use case for near-real-time analytics (large batch + streaming enrichment). Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key takeaways: prioritizing latency under 200ms for the top 3 endpoints; desire to lower per-token costs for high-volume inference; must pass procurement + security checklist for PII handling.
- Action items:
  1) Identify economic buyer / budget owner so we can align pricing and procurement cadence.
  2) Share a tailored pricing summary + mutual action plan (attaching a first draft).
  3) Schedule a 30-min session with procurement/security to walk the SOC2/KMS controls.

I've attached a short pricing summary and a mutual action plan that maps milestones to owners. Can you confirm who on your side owns the budget (economic buyer) and whether procurement should be brought in now or after an initial pricing review?

Proposed times for a quick procurement/security sync: Tue 2/16 10:00–10:30am ET or Wed 2/17 2:00–2:30pm ET. If neither work, share a couple of windows and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments:
- Redwood-pricing-summary-20270214.pdf (pricing overview)
- mutual_action_plan-skyline.xlsx (MAP, editable)

From: Aisha Turner <aisha.turner@skyline.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 13:10:25 -0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood demo — economic buyer & next steps

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the recap and the materials — helpful. A couple of quick items from our side:

- We're aligned on latency goals and the model footprint.
- For procurement/security, I should loop in our procurement alias (procurement@skyline.ai) and our CFO, Sam Patel, who owns the budget. Sam will ultimately sign off on spend > $250k.

I'll add procurement to the thread and intro Sam, but wanted to check if you prefer to share a short one-pager for the CFO that focuses on unit economics and ROI rather than the technical controls. If yes, can Marissa or you send a 1-page summary tailored to budget owners?

Also, Tue 2/16 10:00am ET works for a short procurement sync for us.

Thanks,
Aisha
Director of ML Platforms

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 15:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood demo — economic buyer & next steps

Hi Aisha (and Sam),

Thanks for the quick reply and the intro. Sam — great to e-meet you. Per Aisha's note, we've put together two short artifacts that usually help budget owners:

1) A one-page ROI/unit-economics summary that shows per-token cost at different throughput tiers and expected monthly cost based on your estimated 25M tokens/month.
2) A mutual action plan (attached) that lays out milestones (PO, security review, pilot dates) and suggested owners.

Attaching both: Redwood-pricing-summary-20270214.pdf (one-pager + model options) and mutual_action_plan-skyline.xlsx. If helpful, Marissa can join a 15–20 minute call to walk the one-pager with you.

We can keep Tue 2/16 10:00am ET for procurement/security. If that works for everyone, I'll send a calendar invite. If Sam prefers a separate quick call to review economics before procurement, we're happy to schedule that as well (15–20 mins).

Next steps proposed:
- Confirm Tue 2/16 10:00am ET for procurement/security sync (30 mins).
- Sam: confirm whether you'd like a brief 15-min economics review before procurement.

Thanks and welcome, Sam.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Redwood-pricing-summary-20270214.pdf
- mutual_action_plan-skyline.xlsx

Hi all,

Looping Sam and procurement in as discussed. Sam — Rishi/Marissa from Redwood have provided a one-pager and MAP; they suggested Tue 2/16 10:00am ET for a procurement/security sync. That works for us.

Sam, fyi — you are the budget owner for this initiative; please let us know if you'd like a brief (15-min) economics walk-through before the procurement meeting.

Thanks,
Aisha
